title: Yuki
plot: Alex meets Yuki, his housemate, and gushes about Tokyo.

meets.name: ユキ
meets.about: lives in the share house, makes coffee, plays bass

paragraphs: ユキ|「ユキだよ。よろしくね。」

paragraphs.note: よろしく has no neat English match. Said on meeting someone, it asks them to treat you well from here on, like "nice to meet you" and "I'm counting on you" at once. It's also said when asking a favour.

paragraphs: アレックス|「大きい！人が多い！ビルが高い！」
"So big! So many people! The buildings are so tall!"
